what_happened: The deploy_pending streak-freeze mechanism in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh (Group 29 test fixtures) is an almost-exact structural template for the needed phase-progress freeze: same mt_state persistence pattern (last_dispatch_hash/last_dispatch_phase), same freeze-not-suppress semantics, same per-task read discipline. Additionally, lib/phase-heading-patterns.sh is already sourced unconditionally (not hard-mode-gated) in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, and skill-base.sh's skill_corroborate_phase_counts already demonstrates the exact two-line grep -cE idiom (PHASE_HEADING_ERE / PHASE_HEADING_DONE_ERE) needed to compute an independent phases_completed/phases_total signal from the plan file for any implement dispatch, not just hard-mode ones. This removed most of the design uncertainty for the recommended fix.

Planning discovered a direct conflict the research report did not name: test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's Group 18 (around line 1395-1443) deliberately edits the plan file between two implement builds (appending a phase heading) and asserts the two dispatch bodies hash EQUAL, with the stated premise that the dispatch body is insensitive to plan-file content. The research's option (a) -- emitting PHASES COMPLETED: N of M into every implement dispatch -- makes the body deliberately sensitive to exactly that, so Group 18's assertion must be amended with fresh justification (narrowing the old pin to mtime/size/sha/date-derived content and adding a companion pin for the NEW intended progress sensitivity) rather than silently broken. Planned as its own phase instead of being folded into the option (a) edit.

Planning found a decisive reason the research report's layered recommendation (option b freeze PLUS option a dispatch-body phase-progress line) would be strictly worse than the freeze alone: the two mechanisms share the same gate predicate (plan file resolves, headings conform) and read the same count at the same point in the same loop iteration, so the body line would diverge the hash on exactly every cycle where the freeze would fire. 'Hash matched AND progress advanced' becomes unreachable, the robust persisted-signal branch becomes dead in base mode, and correctness ends up resting entirely on a body line staying out of a strip pattern -- the exact drift-fragility the normalizer's STANDING OBLIGATION warns about and that Group 27 Case F exists to catch. Plan implements the freeze alone, with the reasoning recorded as Decision D2.
